description: Open, update and comment on incidents, request services from the catalog, track problems, read changes, write knowledge base solutions and look up users, groups and hardware in SolarWinds Service Desk, and follow new and changed incidents, problems, changes, solutions and users.

solarwinds_service_desk_change_state_cha.description: Runs when a change request moves to another state, such as Approved.

output.change: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_incident_assigne.description: Runs when an incident or service request is assigned to someone, or to someone else.

output.incident: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_incident_comment.description: Runs when an incident or service request gets a new comment. Hands over the incident.

output.incident: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_incident_sla_bre.description: Runs when an incident or service request breaks one of its SLAs.

output.incident: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_incident_state_c.description: Runs when an incident or service request moves to another state, such as Resolved.

output.incident: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only run when an incident reaches this state. Leave empty for any change.
parameters.name: state

solarwinds_service_desk_incident_updated.description: Runs when an incident or service request changes in any way.

output.incident: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_new_change_trigg.description: Runs when a change request is created.

output.change: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_new_incident_tri.description: Runs when an incident is opened. Service requests have their own trigger.

output.incident: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_new_problem_trig.description: Runs when a problem is opened.

output.problem: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_new_service_requ.description: Runs when someone requests a service from the service catalog.

output.serviceRequest: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_new_solution_tri.description: Runs when a solution article is added to the knowledge base.

output.solution: The record returned by the service

solarwinds_service_desk_new_user_trigger.description: Runs when a person is added to your service desk.

output.user: The record returned by the service
